scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: SLM 生成式高并发推理引擎：延迟约束下的有效吞吐优化
papers.abstract: 本文为SLM（Small Language Model， 小参数量语言模型0.5~1B）在搜推场景的大规模落地提供了一套高性能、可复用的工程实践。
papers.summary: 美团针对搜推中约0.5～1B的小模型有界生成负载，采用静态DAG、AOTInductor、Packed Prefill、请求内KV共享及选择性FP8，压缩通用生成框架的调度开销。Prefill-only约100请求/秒、1500样本/秒，平均端到端延迟低于20毫秒，P99约70毫秒；该负载吞吐约为所比较SGLang路径的10倍。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索的意图分类与相关性判断常只需一次前向，可按完整业务请求编译执行，避免拆成多个生成任务。应先限定输入长度、批量和解码上界，再比较满足延迟目标的有效吞吐；文中10倍收益仅对应特定小模型、接入路径及单卡负载，不能直接外推到开放式长文本生成。

papers.title: CacheSmith: Accurate RAG Serving under Latency SLOs with Adaptive KV Reuse
papers.authors: Xinyue Ma, Damin Lee, Aashaka Shah, Myeongjae Jeon
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.18925v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: This paper presents CacheSmith, a KV cache reuse system for RAG prefill that maximizes quality-gated SLO attainment. While context caching lowers prefill latency by reusing precomputed KV states for retrieved chunks, it misses cross-chunk attention that a full prefill would compute over concatenated inputs. Prior selective recomputation schemes tackle this problem but enforce static, one-size-fits-all configurations that fail to effectively handle request heterogeneity or dynamic latency budgets. CacheSmith decomposes selective recomputation into a three-phase workflow of WarmUp, Probe, and Patch that can be dynamically configured to exploit a wide range of cost-accuracy trade-offs. At serving time, an SLO-aware scheduler in CacheSmith forms batches to mitigate inter-request interference during layer-by-layer prefill, while a budget-aware planner configures recomputation phases across the batch to maximize the number of requests satisf
papers.summary: CacheSmith解决RAG复用文档块KV时跨块注意力缺失、固定重算配置难以适配请求差异的问题。系统将重算拆为WarmUp、Probe和Patch，结合SLO感知组批与预算规划，动态选择成本和质量折中；在4个基准及不同到达率、突发程度下，相对4种先进基线的质量门控SLO达成率最高提高27.5%。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索接入答案生成时，可把答案质量达标且按时返回的请求比例作为缓存优化目标。相比只看缓存命中率或首字延迟，文中的批级规划同时考虑请求间干扰和跨文档信息损失；落地时应先测量不同重算配置的成本质量曲线，再按线上延迟预算选择配置。

papers.title: Delta Tokenizer: Reference-Identical Tokenization of Session Deltas and Segment-Parallelism for Long Prompts on Multicore CPUs
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.19801v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: An agent that drives an LLM sends the model the same conversation again and again, and each turn adds only a little text at the end. Inference engines reuse the KV cache of the shared prefix, so only the new tokens pass through the model. However, tokenization has no such shortcut. The CPU front end of the serving engine converts every request back into token IDs from its first character, which lengthens the time to first token (TTFT) and consumes CPU on every turn.
  We present Delta Tokenizer, a CPU tokenization front end that tokenizes only the delta between a request and the previous request of the same session. It retains the earlier token sequence, encodes again only the appended text and the short tail whose tokens the append could affect, and joins the two only at a position the tokenizer's splitting rules themselves cannot move, which keeps the result exact. For long requests with no state to reuse, it cuts the text where practi
papers.summary: Delta Tokenizer针对多轮会话重复分词的CPU开销，仅重编码新增文本及可能受边界影响的短尾部，并在安全切分点进行多核并行。增量分词约快40倍，16核处理400万字符请求快8.2倍；接入SGLang后，100K上下文的中位首字延迟下降59%，负载下会话P99首字延迟改善9.5倍。
papers.key_insight: 社区问答和连续搜索若重复发送长历史，GPU前缀缓存之外的CPU分词也可能成为瓶颈。可借鉴会话增量状态、安全边界和长短任务共享CPU池的设计，先保证Token序列与参考实现一致；文中部分并行及服务适配组件尚待发布，试用前需核对开源范围与中文文本边界。

papers.title: Your Transformer Is Secretly Elastic
papers.authors: Walter Simoncini, Dheeraj Varghese, Gertjan J. Burghouts, Cees G. M. Snoek
papers.abstract: Scaling up transformers has produced models with broad capabilities, deployed across heterogeneous hardware and fluctuating workloads. Yet, model families offer only a few fixed sizes (e.g., S, B, L), forcing users to commit to a model based on hardware and latency constraints. This rigidity is often suboptimal under varying query loads. We introduce a retraining-free method that elastifies pre-trained transformers into a single model that adapts on-the-fly across a continuum of computational budgets. Our key contribution is a differentiable relaxation of the functional unit-ranking problem: unlike prior work, which optimizes a single importance weight per MLP block or attention head, we rank every individual MLP neuron and attention head jointly, on a common scale, by minimizing the model's loss under soft pruning across many sparsity targets, all at once. Across 27 vision and text transformer encoders ranging from 22M to 8B parameters, our method yields smooth degradation up to 60% s
papers.summary: 该方法把预训练Transformer转换为可随计算预算变化的弹性模型，通过跨多个稀疏率的软剪枝联合排序MLP神经元和注意力头，无需重新训练模型权重。在27个、2200万至80亿参数的视觉与文本编码器上评估；DINOv3剪去50%参数时线性探测准确率下降0.8%，另一视觉模型吞吐最高提高1.80倍。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索中的编码器可探索随流量调整计算预算，用同一模型的不同子结构承接峰谷负载。应保留统一质量评测，检查中文UGC、长尾查询和排序指标在剪枝后的变化；文中1.80倍吞吐来自视觉模型在A100上的测试，不能当作文本检索编码器已验证的加速幅度。

papers.title: PN-Mix: Pair-Norm Guided Mixed-Precision Key Cache Quantization for Efficient Long-Output LLM Inference
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.19605v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Long-output inference in large language models suffers from severe KV cache memory and bandwidth bottlenecks. While KV cache quantization alleviates this issue, low-bit quantization (e.g., 2-bit) severely degrades model accuracy. Recent mixed-precision key-cache quantization methods mitigate this degradation by allocating higher precision to important key channels, but estimate channel saliency using only key statistics. Through attention logit perturbation analysis at the RoPE channel-pair level, we show that quantization errors in channel pairs with large query--key pair-norm products contribute significantly to logit variation. Based on this insight, we propose PN-Mix, a mixed-precision key-cache quantization method for RoPE-based decoder-only LLMs, which allocates higher precision to salient channel pairs identified once during the prefill stage and reused throughout decoding. Across standard reasoning, code-generation, and AIME be
papers.summary: PN-Mix针对长输出推理的KV内存与带宽瓶颈，从RoPE通道对的注意力扰动分析出发，使用查询与键的成对范数乘积识别重要通道。它在prefill阶段一次确定混合精度分配，平均2.26位即可达到或超过使用2.32～2.39位的既有方案，并在精度预算降至1.5位时保持更平缓的退化。
papers.key_insight: 用于社区搜索答案生成时，量化保护对象应反映查询与键的共同作用，而非仅依据键的幅值。一次prefill估计并复用通道优先级，有助于控制解码期间的额外开销；但公开摘要主要支持准确率与位宽结论，实际吞吐、缓存元数据开销及长短输出混合流量仍需单独测量。

papers.title: JointServe: Serving Multi-Model Agents on Memory-Constrained GPUs
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.19822v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: LLM agents are evolving from a single model calling tools to planners that orchestrate multiple expert models whose capabilities live in distinct weights. This shift breaks a hidden assumption of today's serving systems: that the working set of models fits in GPU memory. On the memory-constrained GPUs typical of private and edge deployments, naive whole-model swapping serializes weight transfer with computation and, without host-backed KV restoration, discards session state at a switch. We present JointServe, a serving system that treats weight shards and KV blocks as residency objects competing for one unified memory budget. JointServe exploits three structural properties of agent workloads (directed calls, gapped execution, and dual-state residency) to prepare models before they are called: an intent signal parsed from the caller's own output stream triggers prefetch during generation, partial k* residency reduces switching to increm
papers.summary: JointServe面向显存无法容纳全部专家模型的多模型服务，把权重分片和KV块纳入统一驻留预算，通过调用意图预取、部分层驻留和可抢占传输调度降低切换成本。相对最强整模型交换基线，会话完成时间减少21.7%；在SWE-bench等轨迹回放中最高减少49%，SLO达成率由2.8%～24.5%提升至76.8%～100%。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索若组合查询理解、重排和生成模型，可参考统一管理权重与会话缓存，而非为每个模型独立预留显存。预取收益依赖调用方向和空闲窗口，需用真实流量评估误预取、带宽竞争和缓存恢复；论文采用代理任务轨迹回放，其收益还不能直接代表在线搜索链路。

papers.title: Latent Compaction with Test-Time Training
papers.authors: Yingfa Chen, Xingyu Shen, Chaojun Xiao, Xu Han
papers.abstract: Long contexts enlarge key--value (KV) caches, increasing memory use and attention costs during generation. Compressing these caches must preserve information for unseen questions. We introduce **Latent Compaction**, which learns a compact document-specific cache through test-time training. We initialize cache entries using reconstruction importance, teacher attention, and key-space diversity. Training first fits attention outputs and log-normalizers to those of the full cache, with reconstruction-selected entries held fixed. It then jointly optimizes the entire cache through end-to-end distillation from the full-cache model. Model weights remain frozen throughout, and training uses only generic prompts about the document, without access to downstream questions or answers. Experiments on RULER, LongBench, and Phonebook Lookup demonstrate substantial gains over budget-matched compression baselines. On a RULER, for example, our method achieves 96.7% accuracy at 32times compression, compar
papers.summary: Latent Compaction将文档KV缓存视为可优化参数，在冻结模型权重的前提下进行文档级测试时训练。它结合重建重要性、教师注意力与键空间多样性初始化缓存，再进行注意力拟合和端到端蒸馏；在RULER的32倍压缩设置下准确率达到96.7%，相同预算的KVZip+为40.0%，并在多个检索基准上评估。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索可对高复用长文档离线优化紧凑缓存，把额外计算摊销到后续多次问答。方法训练时不使用下游问题答案，这有助于保持问题未知时的复用价值；但频繁更新的UGC和低命中文档未必能收回优化成本，实施时应同时统计构建时间、缓存寿命、命中率及答案质量。

papers.title: Beyond the Trial-and-Error Loop: Hybrid Projection and Automated Tuning for Distributed Training
papers.authors: Anshu Raina, Peyman Razaghi, Yuankai Chen, Cheng Yao, Yao Fu, Vidushi Goyal, Devang Patel, Wen Xie, Zhenyu Gu, Emad Barsoum
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.19423v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Configuring distributed LLM training across hundreds of GPUs requires jointly optimizing tensor, pipeline, expert, context, and data parallelism alongside micro-batch size, recomputation, sharding, and overlap, a combinatorial space where memory legality can hinge on a single byte of activation accounting. Today, teams navigate it through expensive multi-node trial and error, burning GPU-hours on crashes and suboptimal recipes. We present Primus Projection, which closes this loop with two coupled components. First, a hybrid projection engine that measures what it can and simulates what it cannot: GPU microbenchmarks on as few as a single device capture compute kernels and any in-scope communication; a sub-node downscale-measure-upscale workflow analytically restores out-of-scope collectives, FSDP overlap, and the full pipeline schedule at the multi-node target. A pure simulation mode runs entirely on CPU, enabling pre-silicon planning
papers.summary: Primus Projection结合单设备微基准与分析模拟，预测大规模训练的吞吐和内存合法性，再通过确定性规划器与LLM调参循环搜索并行配置。DeepSeek V3在1024张GPU上的吞吐预测误差为4.7%，Qwen3在256张GPU上为1.9%；Mixtral案例在不足30分钟单节点探索后，相对同规模参考配置吞吐提高27%。
papers.key_insight: 搜推团队训练语言模型时，可先用低成本预测排除内存不可行配置，再把昂贵的多机试跑留给少数候选。应关注张量、流水线、专家和数据并行之间的组合效应，并在自己的GPU与网络环境校准通信模型；对于只做小规模微调的团队，该方案的直接收益低于大集群场景。

papers.title: SpectrumQuant: Spectrum Alignment for LLM Quantization
papers.authors: Dwaipayan Haldar, Indranil Patra, Azhar Yousuf, Chandra Sekhar Seelamantula
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.20303v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Orthogonal transforms have emerged as an effective tool for low-bit quantization of large language models (LLMs), as they reshape activation distributions without changing the underlying model function. Existing approaches typically rely either on fixed data-agnostic transforms, such as Hadamard rotations, or on calibration-time optimization of learned rotations. We study rotation selection from first principles and show that maximizing covariance leads to spectral alignment and provides a principled criterion for constructing quantization-friendly orthogonal transforms. Based on this insight, we propose SpectrumQuant, a closed-form rotation method that estimates activation covariance from calibration data and uses it to construct a covariance-aware orthogonal transform for post-training quantization. Our formulation characterizes quantization-friendly rotations as compositions of alignment and mixing components, while recovering Hadamar
papers.summary: SpectrumQuant从激活协方差出发构造闭式正交旋转，通过谱对齐与混合改善低位量化，而不执行学习式旋转的迭代优化。方法把Hadamard及一类蝶形矩阵纳入统一解释，在Llama与Mistral上取得与先进旋转策略有竞争力的结果；相对SpinQuant和DartQuant等学习式方法，所需GPU内存低于三分之一。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索部署语言模型时，可考虑把量化校准的资源成本也纳入方案选择。数据感知的闭式旋转提供了固定旋转与昂贵学习旋转之间的折中；需要用中文UGC校准集检验离群激活与语义变化，并确认目标推理内核是否支持该变换，避免校准阶段的节省被在线转换开销抵消。

papers.title: KV4-RL: Unlocking Faster Asynchronous Rollouts for RLVR with INT4 KV Cache Quantization
papers.authors: Sihwan Park, Sung-Yub Kim, Doohyuk Jang, Eunho Yang
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.14448v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Asynchronous rollout improves the efficiency of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) by reducing under-utilization during long-tail generation. Sustained concurrency also concentrates context processing into fewer decode steps, increasing the KV workload per step. We characterize this \emph{KV concentration} and find that KV cache quantization delivers substantially greater acceleration than weight-only and weight-activation quantization in our matched-workload comparisons. However, INT4 KV rollout can degrade learning even with token-level truncated importance sampling (TIS). We propose \emph{KV4-RL}, which combines calibration-free INT4 KV quantization with selective INT8 protection of attention sinks and recent context. Protecting a bounded number of positions reduces sampler mismatch while retaining most of the speedup from INT4. Across 400 iterations of Qwen3-8B-Base GRPO training, KV4-RL achieves $1.80\times$ cum
papers.summary: KV4-RL针对异步RLVR采样中的KV负载集中与低精度采样偏差，以免校准INT4缓存配合注意力汇聚位置和近期上下文的选择性INT8保护。Qwen3-8B的400轮GRPO训练中，累计采样加速1.80倍、完整训练迭代加速1.27倍；使用共同BF16评估器时，两种规模模型的最终六基准平均准确率差距在0.5个百分点内。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索若用可验证奖励训练生成或推理模型，应把采样吞吐、训练迭代耗时和最终质量分开衡量。量化采样器改变行为分布，即使有重要性采样修正也可能损害学习；可借鉴对少量关键位置保留更高精度的办法，并在相同评估精度和训练预算下复核收益。
papers.recency_note: 首次发表于2026-10-10；本次窗口内RSS公告收录，时效性按首次发表日期评分。
